campaign.title: Black Friday Watchlist
campaign.intro: The products I’m watching for real Black Friday markdowns. Check today’s price on Amazon before you buy, since deals can end anytime.

picks.title: Fire TV Stick 4K
picks.why: Turns any TV into a smart TV in a few minutes. An easy gift for parents or a dorm room.

picks.title: Kindle Paperwhite
picks.why: Glare-free screen, weeks of battery and waterproof. The one I’d pick for anyone who reads in bed.

picks.title: Echo Dot
picks.why: Small smart speaker for music, timers and reminders. Works well as a kitchen or bedroom add-on.

picks.title: Ring Video Doorbell
picks.why: See who’s at the door from your phone. Practical for anyone who gets a lot of packages.

picks.title: Apple AirPods Pro 2
picks.why: Noise cancelling that works on commutes and flights. Worth it if they use an iPhone; skip it for Android.

picks.title: Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones
picks.why: Over-ear noise cancelling with long battery life. Great for travel or working from home.

picks.title: Robot vacuum (iRobot Roomba or Shark)
picks.why: Keeps floors under control between real cleans. Best for homes with pets or busy schedules.

picks.title: Ninja air fryer
picks.why: Crispy food without heating the whole oven. A gift people actually use every week.

picks.title: Instant Pot
picks.why: Pressure cooker, slow cooker and rice cooker in one. Saves counter space and weeknight time.

picks.title: LEGO Botanicals flower set
picks.why: A relaxing build that ends up as decor. A fun gift for adults, not just kids.
